name: Date Range Widget
description: Date range validation widget with configurable min/max dates and relative date support.
project_description: Date Range Widget (drw) is a lightweight field widget for core single-value datetime fields that enforces a minimum and/or maximum allowed date. Bounds can be absolute (2000-01-01) or relative expressions parsed by DrupalDateTime such as "today", "-18 years", "+90 days" or "+1 year". The widget forces date-only entry (no time component), emits HTML5 min/max attributes for client-side hints, and its bounds are enforced server-side by a dynamically added DateRange validation constraint. Custom, translatable error messages with @min/@max placeholders are optional. Typical uses are age verification, future-only dates, event periods and booking windows. The module ships no routes, no permissions, no Drush commands and no external dependencies or JavaScript; all configuration lives in the widget settings on Manage form display.
